title: DocuSign Momentum Conference
summary: Event branding and creative direction for DocuSign Momentum across venue, presentations, website, app, and virtual sessions.
overview: I led the branding and creative direction for DocuSign Momentum. The work spanned event materials, presentations, digital experiences, website and app oversight, and support for virtual sessions.

projectBrief.context: DocuSign Momentum Conference brought customers, partners, and company leaders together around the product and its broader agreement story.
projectBrief.challenge: The conference needed a consistent identity across the venue, presentations, digital tools, and virtual-session materials.
projectBrief.contribution: I led the event branding and creative direction across physical materials, presentations, website and app oversight, digital experiences, and virtual-session support.
projectBrief.approach: I used a shared visual system and presentation structure to connect attendee touchpoints before, during, and beyond the live event.
projectBrief.outcome: The work delivered a coordinated conference experience across physical, presentation, web, app, and virtual formats.
